notes: Scanner predictions are counted and are not expected identity.
Perceptual hashes cover source frames. sha256 covers every inventoried image.
The Scryfall art-crop cache is not phone evidence and is not in this image total.

usefulness.single-card: Recognition, after a human confirms the physical card.
usefulness.deck: Recognition across one physical stack. Frames stay in one split.
usefulness.geometry: Detector and warp. Recorded quads are not ground truth.
usefulness.binder: Future multi-card detection. Excluded from the V1 single-card score.
usefulness.capture-quality: Snapshot versus photo of one presentation.
usefulness.phone-trace: Debug traces. A human label is required before scoring.
usefulness.replay: Explicit identities plus recorded OCR. Sanity set, not overall accuracy.
